# Instagram Reel Scraper

The Apify actor [`apify/instagram-reel-scraper`](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-reel-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.618**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Scrape or download Instagram reels. Just add Instagram profile or reel URL, and get caption, timestamp, transcript, hashtags, mentions, tagged users, comments, likes, shares, views, duration, and downloaded video. Export scraped data, schedule via API, and integrate with other tools or AI workflows.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Reel $0.0026, Actor start $0.001, Add-on: Shares count $0.007, Add-on: Transcript $0.048, Add-on: Video download $0.02 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/apify/instagram-reel-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/apify-instagram-reel-scraper@0.0.618#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs:
      username: []
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `username` | array | yes |  | 🎞️ Instagram username, profile URL, ID, reel URL or audio URL — Add Instagram usernames, profile URLs, IDs, or direct reel URLs. Each item will be processed individually. |
| `resultsLimit` | integer |  |  | 💯 Maximum reels per profile — Set how many reels should be scraped per profile or URL. For example, if set to 5, the scraper will extract up to 5 reels from each profile. This setting is ignored when scraping direct reel URLs. |
| `onlyPostsNewerThan` | string |  |  | 📅 Scrape reels newer than — Scrape reels from the provided date up to the present. For audio URLs this filter is ignored. Supported formats include `YYYY-MM-DD`, full ISO timestamps (e.g. `2025-09-23T10:02:01`), or relative time such as `1 day`, `2 weeks`, or `3 months`. All times are evaluated in  |
| `skipPinnedPosts` | boolean |  | `false` | 📌 Skip pinned reels — Enable this option if you want to exclude pinned reels from the overall results. |
| `skipTrialReels` | boolean |  | `false` | 🎬 Skip trial reels — If enabled, the feed will be scraped without trial reels: an Instagram feature creators use to test a video with non-followers before sharing it with their existing audience. Learn more (https://creators.instagram.com/blog/instagram-trial-reels). |
| `includeSharesCount` | boolean |  | `false` | $ Include shares count — Extract the number of shares for each reel. Available for paying users only. Upgrade to the Starter plan (https://console.apify.com/billing/subscription) to unlock it. |
| `includeTranscript` | boolean |  | `false` | $ Include transcript — Extract a text transcript of the reel audio for content analysis. This add-on feature (https://apify.com/apify/instagram-reel-scraper/pricing) is charged per minute of audio. |
| `includeDownloadedVideo` | boolean |  | `false` | $ Include downloaded video — Download the reel video and store a local copy before Instagram links expire. This add-on feature (https://apify.com/apify/instagram-reel-scraper/pricing) is charged per 1 MB downloaded. |
